items.mainDefect: The authorization check uses AND, wrongly denying team admins who are not owners.

secondary.defect: Bookings without a team trigger unnecessary authorization queries using teamId 0.

items.mainDefect: Passing raw guests to sendAddGuestsEmails gives existing attendees duplicate booking-confirmation emails.

secondary.defect: The catch block silently swallows email errors without logging them.

items.mainDefect: Guest emails are compared without normalization, allowing case changes to bypass the blacklist.

secondary.defect: Case-sensitive attendee comparisons allow the same email address to be added more than once.

items.mainDefect: The unbounded guest array allows attendees to trigger bulk organizer invitations, enabling email spam.

secondary.defect: The handler does not enforce seat capacity and can overfill seated events.
The handler ignores seatsShowAttendees restrictions and can expose attendee email addresses.
The handler allows adding guests to cancelled or past bookings.

items.mainDefect: The invalid-email state is not reset, leaving stale errors visible after edits, successful submissions, or reopening.

secondary.defect: Closing the dialog through onOpenChange leaves previously entered emails in multiEmailValue.
The always-truthy error message template prevents the translated fallback from running.

items.mainDefect: Unnormalized guest emails can bypass the lowercased blacklist through case changes.

secondary.defect: Case-sensitive comparisons against existing attendees allow duplicate email addresses with different casing.

items.mainDefect: The blacklist comparison fails to lowercase guest emails, allowing differently cased blocked addresses through.

secondary.defect: The existing-attendee comparison also fails to normalize casing, allowing duplicate attendees.

items.mainDefect: Guest uniqueness is enforced only on the client, leaving the server without adequate normalization and deduplication.

secondary.defect: Concurrent requests can insert duplicate attendees because the read and insert lack concurrency-safe uniqueness enforcement.
Passing raw guests instead of uniqueGuests to sendAddGuestsEmails incorrectly treats existing attendees as newly added.
